description: The comparability families of this city's runs, declared once so the cross-run index (issue #77, src/analyse/build_run_index.py) can label every run directory mechanically instead of each reader re-deriving the boundaries from DECISIONS.md. A family boundary is a recorded model/data/network change after which nothing compares to what ran before it (DECISIONS.md 3.5 and the per-boundary entries below). Runs are assigned to the newest family whose from_launch stamp is <= their launch stamp; the overrides block wins where the record attributes a run explicitly or the launch date alone cannot settle it. THIS FILE IS A RECORD OF DECIDED BOUNDARIES, not a place to invent one - a new family is declared here in the same change as its DECISIONS.md entry.

F1-postrebuild-prerepair.label: post-rebuild, pre-repair (the 9.43 pilot family)
F1-postrebuild-prerepair.note: The issue #32 rebuild made everything before 16 Aug incomparable and results/ was already empty. Pilot arms conv1000_10pct / conv1000_25pct are this family's record.

F2-ride-binding.label: ride sampler + escort binding + age structure (9.44-9.47)
F2-ride-binding.note: The 18 Aug triple break. bind1000_25pct (20260818T235351) is the family's last and only completed arm.

F3-all-physical.label: freight + all-physical modes (9.49-9.55)
F3-all-physical.note: Freight changed the demand AND the model. No completed 1000-iteration arm: the 9.50 base arm was stopped by instruction, the 9.57 attempt stopped at iteration 136.

F4-walk-wedge.label: walk-wedge network repairs + lifts + PassingQ (9.58-9.63) - CLOSED
F4-walk-wedge.note: The CLOSED family whose record is the two completed arms 20260821T175907 / 20260821T180310 (9.64) - the pre-repair baseline every next-arm comparison is made against.

F5-ride-walk-repairs.label: round-trip ride bindings + short-trip mixture (9.68-9.69) - CLOSED UNMEASURED
F5-ride-walk-repairs.note: B2/plans/run inputs regenerated 24 Aug on the repaired mechanisms. NO CONVERGED ARM EVER RAN IN THIS FAMILY: the 4.6.9 arm was launch-blocked (9.72), and the 9.77 activation closed the family before it was measured. Its byte-identical inputs are regenerable by setting A.signals.representation=implicit_delay and A.crossings.representation=absent and removing taxi from the two RUN vocabularies, should the repairs-first ordering ever be revived. The 25 Aug batch was BUILT INERT inside this family (9.76).

F6-all-modes-activated.label: explicit signals + tram/bus priority + crossings + native dwell + taxi (9.77) - CURRENT
F6-all-modes-activated.note: The 9.77 activation boundary: A.signals.representation=explicit_signals (signal plans at the 14 corridor intersections, saturation-flow re-capacitation, each variant's own embedded tram delay removed from the schedule), A.crossings.representation=change_events (the two freight level crossings as a time-variant network), taxi in both RUN vocabularies (one blended priced mode), travel-time bin 300 s, usingFastCapacityUpdate=false, dwell carried by the signals-transformed schedules. ONE boundary per 9.75/9.76; run inputs regenerated 25 Aug. The same-session 9.78 lanes FOLD IN while the family has no arms (still one boundary): score-distinct PT submodes (RUN.routing.pt_submode_scoring=per_submode) and the CWANZ-cited bike availability 0.493 with its plans regeneration. The 9.76 detached probe 20260825T033850 (launched 03:38) is F5; the activated probes from 09:44 on are F6.

F7-ride-alternative-retained.label: the unpaired-ride fallback stops deleting the plan's ride alternative (9.81) - CURRENT
F7-ride-alternative-retained.note: RidePairingEngine re-moded an unpaired ride leg to a network walk BY MUTATING THE PLAN, so pairing failure destroyed the alternative while pairing success created none - a one-way ratchet measured on the aborted F6 arm 20260825T135734: 95.7% of the 61,409 iteration-0 misses gone by iteration 1, occupancy decaying with a 36-iteration half-life toward the pre-repair 0.0013. The forced walk is now an EXECUTION: the leg's mode and route are restored at AfterMobsim, after the events scoring reads, so the walk is still charged in full and 9.55 is kept intact while the plan retains ride for co-evolution to re-select. NO PARAMETER CHANGED - B.ride.remode_unpaired stays true and B.ride.pairing_window_min stays 15.0, a window widening having been refused by measurement (median gap to an endpoint-matching driver 253.7 min). ride_pairing.csv additionally gains the miss funnel and gap distribution, which is reporting only. F6 produced no converged arm, exactly as F5 did not.

F8-escort-coherence.label: the escort and the escorted stop taking different modes (9.82)
F8-escort-coherence.note: B2 generates escort travel as a PAIR (B2_escort_bindings_<DAY>.csv, 125,475 weekday rows from census household structure and the HTS escort rates) and MATSim replans the two agents independently, so SubtourModeChoice - which moves one agent at a time - cannot propose the two-sided state and the pair cannot recohere once lost. Measured on the F7 arm 20260826T060938 at iteration 150: 84.53% of trips arriving at an escort activity are car while only 11.45% of escort-bound members ride, so the escort tours run largely empty and ride is suppressed while car and bike are inflated. EscortCoherenceListener PROPOSES the coherent plan back to a member who has drifted off ride; ChangeExpBeta scores it like any other plan and keeps it only if it earns its place, and the driver is never touched. NO MODE'S UTILITY CHANGES and nothing is fitted: the one new field, B.ride.escort_coherence_rate (0.10, swept [0.0, 0.5]), is a SEARCH rate whose ZERO RECOVERS F7 EXACTLY. Carries the 9.81 ride-alternative restore unchanged. Validated at 25% x 2 (20260826T220340, rc 0) before launch. CORRECTION within the family: the first build re-moded one trip of a subtour and died at iteration 2 on a mixed chain/non-chain subtour (arm 20260826T222352); the listener now converts the WHOLE subtour and only offers ride to a member who cannot drive themselves. Validated by probe_replanning_25pct (20260826T224343, rc 0, eight iterations so innovation stays on through 6.4) after the 25% x 2 probe proved structurally blind to replanning.

F9-joint-demand-gradient-gates.label: the demand ceiling mechanism, gradient link speed and the age gates (9.84)
F9-joint-demand-gradient-gates.note: Three root-cause builds activating as ONE boundary under the renewed gate-loop goal (9.84). (1) bind_joint_tours, the third B2 binder pass: adult joint household travel generated as PAIRS - a companion tour mirrors a licensed co-member driver tour (same endpoints and times, party_size 2, dest_placement joint), volume anchored on the DERIVED occupancy ratio (B.activity.joint_tour_passenger_ratio = C.constraint.vehicle_occupancy - 1 = 0.3503) times the observed HTS driver share, with escort/lift-covered trips counted first; companions seed ride, drivers seed car; EscortCoherenceListener gains a JOINT path at B.ride.joint_coherence_rate whose ZERO recovers the escort-only behaviour. The demand, plans and every run-input set regenerate, which is what breaks comparability with F6/F7/F8. (2) Gradient reaches walk and bike link travel time on BOTH router and mobsim sides behind A.gradient.representation=link_speed: grade_pct stamped per link from A1/A6 node elevations (81.9% of walk/bike links matched, clamp declared), Tobler 1993 for walk and Parkin & Rotheram 2010 for bike, every constant declared and swept; GradientSignalsNetworkFactory ports the signals node logic verbatim so signals and gradient survive together, lanes refused loudly. (3) Age availability gates: B.taxi.min_unaccompanied_age 18 [0,18] and B.population.bike_min_age 12 [0,16], assumed, labelled, ZERO DISABLES, consumed by AvailabilityModesCalculator via the new modeAvailability module. The 9.60 non-household scope stays same_zone - measured as 98% consumed, driver supply is the binding constraint. Registry 357 to 370. NOTHING in the family is a result until an arm carries _run.json.

F10-declared-pair-identity.label: the declared pair survives translation, and the mutation that breaks it is declared (9.85) - CLOSED UNMEASURED
F10-declared-pair-identity.note: ONE boundary, opened on the F9 gate-2 arm being stopped at iteration 100 with all five scored categories past the 20% bar and 9.84's driver-side pass measured INERT at equal depth (mean abs error 10.920 -> 10.864, ride 4.91 -> 4.87). The located cause is a translation loss, not a choice defect: all three B2 binding tables NAME the driver (joint 70,964 rows, escort 109,971, lift 45,602), build_matsim_plans.py read that identity to decide SEEDING and then discarded it, so nothing in the MATSim population recorded that two people were a pair and RidePairingEngine had to re-discover each one from geometry plus the 15-minute B.ride.pairing_window_min - while MATSim's own TimeAllocationMutator moved the two members apart independently at a +-1800 s default NO registry field declared. Measured at iteration 100: 73.8% / 67.4% / 80.5% of joint / escort / lift bound ride legs still had their declared driver making the same-endpoint trip BY CAR, but only 60.6% / 42.6% / 64.5% fell inside the window; pair_rate had decayed 0.556 -> 0.362 and occupancy_from_pairings 0.3097 -> 0.0956 against a measured 0.3503. (1) build_matsim_plans.py writes boundDriver from ALL THREE tables - 158,898 persons; the joint table alone would have covered 46% of affected legs and left escort, the worst-hit, still on the clock. (2) RUN.replanning.time_mutation_range_s is DECLARED and swept [600, 1800] (timeAllocationMutator.mutationRange, group name verified against pt2matsim-26.6-shaded.jar) - it had been reaching the mobsim as an undeclared framework default. (3) B.ride.bound_pairing_window_min is DERIVED from it by identity and relaxes IDENTIFICATION ONLY: the inferred window stays 15 min, endpoints / capacity / physical boarding still decide, the gap becomes waiting time the passenger pays for in score, and the config group REFUSES a bound window narrower than the inferred one. Setting the two equal recovers F9 exactly. Booking now carries the tolerance it was made under, because JointRideEngine bounded the PHYSICAL wait by the narrow window - without that the pair rate rises while nobody boards (the trap-6/7 class), which is why the first build was stopped rather than measured. NO mode utility changed and no target moved. The population regenerates, which is what breaks comparability with F9. New telemetry paired_declared / paired_by_identity makes the effect measurable: at iteration 0, before any drift, paired_by_identity is 7 of 62,359. NOTHING in the family is a result until an arm carries _run.json. CLOSED UNMEASURED (9.86): no arm in this family ever produced a result - its only launches were the 1-iteration abort 20260828T214601 and the 5-iteration plumbing probe 20260828T204105, both stopped on instruction. The build itself is KEPT and carries forward into F11 unchanged; what closes the family is the taxi network-loading change, not a defect in the pair-identity repair.

F11-taxi-physical.label: taxi physically simulated in the mobsim (9.86) - CLOSED UNMEASURED
F11-taxi-physical.note: ONE boundary, and it is a NETWORK-LOADING change: RUN.qsim.main_mode gains taxi, so ~40,000 occupied taxi vehicle-trips per iteration that were teleported (39,892 of 39,923 legs measured on the F9 gate-2 arm, issue #88) now occupy links, queues and count stations at the declared PCE of 1.0. Every link travel time, every count comparison and every mode share is therefore read on a different road from F10 and earlier, and nothing before this stamp compares to anything after it. The taxi vehicle body restates RUN.qsim.car_vehicle exactly rather than declaring a second one - a hired car is a car - and empty running (deadheading) is deliberately NOT modelled and NOT assumed, because the Newcastle empty-running share is unobserved. Everything F10 built is kept: boundDriver from all three B2 binding tables, the declared RUN.replanning.time_mutation_range_s, and B.ride.bound_pairing_window_min derived from it by identity. Validated on the 1% 2-iteration probe 20260828T220751_2it_1pct: rc=0, accounting closes, 197 of 197 taxi departures enter traffic against 0 before, 29,994 taxi link traversals, and all 2,300,485 link-entry events attributed to a vehicle class. NOTHING IN THIS FAMILY IS A RESULT until an arm carries a _run.json. CLOSED UNMEASURED (9.88): its only arm, 20260828T221500, was stopped on instruction at iteration 5 when the directive was amended to require SCATS be derived rather than swept - the arm was running on assumed signalling and its gate would have been superseded by the signal change regardless. Everything F11 built is kept and carries into F12.

F12-scats-adaptive.label: SCATS adaptive signals + derived crossings + derived ferry target (9.88-9.90) - CURRENT
F12-scats-adaptive.note: ONE boundary, and it changes what the corridor COSTS to drive: A.signals.control_regime flips to scats_adaptive, so the 14 corridor intersections stop executing a fixed 110 s plan and re-time themselves every cycle from measured degree of saturation - cycle length stepping toward a target DS on the critical movement, splits equalising DS across stages, clearances preserved, offsets deliberately NOT adapted. Corridor travel time, the queues the light rail sits in, and every count comparison therefore differ from F11 and earlier, and nothing before this stamp compares to anything after it. Transit priority is unchanged in effect but now lives inside the adaptive controller. Everything F10 and F11 built is kept: boundDriver from all three B2 binding tables, the declared time_mutation_range_s, and taxi as a qsim main mode. Also in this family: the ferry target stops being unobtained and becomes derived (9.89), which changes no model input - only what mode 10 is gated against. Also in this family (9.90): the level-crossing closures stop being 30 assumed uniform per site and are DERIVED from the mapped rail timetable - Adamstown 110 and Islington 204 per weekday, timed where the trains actually run, 541 to 3,014 change events. That changes road capacity at two real locations and their time profile, so it belongs to this boundary rather than a new one - NO ARM HAS RUN IN F12, so folding it in loses nothing. Also folded in (9.93): B.ride.escort_coherence_rate and B.ride.joint_coherence_rate rise 0.1 -> 0.4, a SEARCH parameter rather than a preference - the coherence listener proposes and ChangeExpBeta disposes, so a higher rate only reduces the chance that a two-sided state no per-agent strategy can reach is never offered. Folded here rather than opening F13 because NO ARM HAS RUN IN F12, so nothing is lost. NOTHING IN THIS FAMILY IS A RESULT until an arm carries a _run.json.

F13-taxi-fleet.label: finite taxi fleet, refused request walks (9.99)
F13-taxi-fleet.note: Declared here on 30 Aug (9.120) for a boundary the record had already named: 9.99 gave taxi a sample-scaled fleet at the BeforeMobsim boundary, and arm 20260829T172145 was the first to carry it. The DECISIONS entries of 29-30 Aug (9.108, 9.116) count F13 and F14 as families; this file had not been updated with either, so the index labelled their arms F12. Nothing in this family is a result.

F14-servable-pool-motorbike-carve.label: joint-binding candidate-pool filter + motorbike carve conversion rebuild (9.116)
F14-servable-pool-motorbike-carve.note: The 9.116 rebuild: demand, plans and the 30 run-input sets regenerated at 02:13 on 30 Aug with the 9.111 filter and the 9.115 carve applied together. Arms 20260830T022430 / T024952 / T075138 died on the subtour-mix defect (9.119), T082015 was the diagnostic, and T083019 - the first to survive it - died at iteration 38 of a console stop (9.120). No arm in this family reached a gate.

F15-choice-set-seed-bound-ride.label: full-choice-set seed + per-trip bound ride/drive + declared-pair re-timing (9.120)
F15-choice-set-seed-bound-ride.note: Opened 30 Aug 12:40: population, attributes (boundRideTrips/boundDriveTrips), seed method (B.mode.seed_method = full_choice_set, plan memory 8) and two controler classes (GatedSubtourModeChoice, RidePairingEngine) changed together. The F14 arm 20260830T083019 died at iteration 38 before this boundary (0xC000013A console stop, trigger not established) and is F14. First F15 arm: 10% x 300 iterations under overlay f15_gate_10pct.

F16-choice-set-seed-drawn-order.label: F15 stack with the first-executed seed plan drawn uniformly (9.121)
F16-choice-set-seed-drawn-order.note: Opened 30 Aug 13:30: only the population file changes - which seeded plan carries selected="yes" - drawn uniformly by a hash of person id and master seed instead of car-first. The F15 arm 20260830T124711 was stopped at iteration 13 with its cause measured (car plans scored under the iteration-0 gridlock the car-first order created) and is F15. First F16 arm under overlay f16_gate_10pct.

F17-network-direct-walk.label: F16 stack with the PT router direct walk evaluated on the network (9.121, #94)
F17-network-direct-walk.note: Opened 30 Aug 14:05: the pt routing module is wrapped (citysim.NetworkDirectWalkPtRouter) so the direct walk the raptor compares every transit route against is the walk network route, not a beeline across the harbour; RUN.transit_router.direct_walk_basis = network, direct_walk_factor declared at its default 1.0. The F16 arm 20260830T132843 was stopped at iteration 17 with the cause measured (38.3% of pt-plan trips walk-only, 45.5% of them over 3 km on the network) and is F16. First F17 arm under overlay f17_gate_10pct.

F18-shared-rides-carves.label: F17 stack on a demand with shared rides, the repaired motorbike carve at census resolution and the resident truck carve (9.122, 9.124, 9.125)
F18-shared-rides-carves.note: Opens at the first F18 launch (stamp provisional until then): B2 rebuilt with the fourth binder pass (B.ride.shared_lift_scope = same_sa2_od), plans rebuilt with the motorbike carve solved on non-escorters at sa1_thinned resolution and the resident truck carve. The run side is F17 unchanged. The F17 arm 20260830T141222 is F17 to whatever iteration it reaches.
